brief: Publications for Sorrento Therapeutics trial NCT04903327 (COVI-MSC, phase 2, terminated for slow enrollment; primary completion 2022-08-29; results never posted to the registry). Was a paper reporting its results ever published?

findings.claim: No results publication found for Sorrento Therapeutics trial NCT04903327 (COVI-MSC).
findings.notes: No results publication found in snapshot or PubMed. Five articles were found that only mention the trial (mention_only), consisting of reviews and background papers.
